title: Open-DV Ontology Construction Studio Closed Error Code Catalog
description: Normative, authoritative machine-readable catalog of all closed error codes across CLI exit codes (0..7), HTTP status codes, categories, and waivability rules.

strict_precedence: 4. Body Parse & Field Uniqueness (exit 2 / HTTP 400 for syntax; exit 4 / HTTP 422 for location uniqueness)
5. Envelope Segregation (exit 4 / HTTP 422 for envelope; exit 7 for automated destructive)
7. Field Authorization (exit 7 before semantic waiver exit 4)
9. Optimistic Concurrency Control (exit 5 / HTTP 412; base mismatch exit 2)
10. Referential & ONT-EVO Governance (exit 4 / HTTP 422; no-op delta exit 1 / HTTP 400)

exit_codes.1: System & Capability Failure / Missing Required Rationale (HTTP 400, 500, 503)
exit_codes.4: Domain & Referential Integrity Violation / ONT-EVO Governance (HTTP 422)

error_codes.description: Operation completed successfully.
LLM agent backend or reasoning harness unreachable or exhausted.
Conflicting workspace seeding parameters provided during session initialization.
Session JSON or meta record corrupted, malformed, or unparseable.
Export rationale missing or blank when exporting confidential or tainted session bundle.
Rationale missing or blank when acknowledging historical contract warnings.
Acknowledgement rationale missing or blank when importing session with unverified grounding or self-accepted proposals.
Studio root or session directory permissions insecure (requires 0700/0600 DACL).

error_codes.problem_title: Background Job Abandoned Due to Server Crash
error_codes.description: Background job abandoned due to worker crash or unhandled server process termination.

error_codes.problem_title: Matcher Unicode Character Tables Version Mismatch
error_codes.description: Runtime Unicode character tables or tokenization version diverge from pinned specification.
Delta contains no semantic modifications or workspace promotion contains zero edits beyond seed root.
Optical Character Recognition engine or dependency unavailable for complex document layout.
LibreOffice / soffice conversion engine unavailable for binary office document ingestion.
Promotion rationale is missing, blank, or empty when promoting session to workspace.
Reference ontology pack file corrupted or digest does not match registry entry.
Disk IO failure or atomic replacement error while persisting committed version artifacts.
Character start offset greater than or equal to end offset, or span length exceeds 1000 characters.
Wildcard If-Match: * or weak ETag W/"..." supplied where strong exact SHA is required.
Session identifier invalid (must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$, no reserved Windows device names or route keywords).
Workspace directory path does not resolve within OPENDV_WORKSPACE_ROOTS containment boundary.
Auto-commit construction request missing required base_version or base_sha256 pin.
Required If-Match or X-OpenDV-Workspace-If-Match precondition header missing from request.
If-Match header does not match body base_sha256, or proposal base_version does not match active_version.
Server path flag specified across remote network client boundary (disallowed in client-server mode).
Syntax validation failure, missing required CLI flag, malformed payload, or unknown field.
Ambiguous target specifier (e.g. relationship_uri mismatch with slug or conflicting target_kind/concept_uri).
Specified background execution job identifier does not exist.
Specified proposal identifier does not exist in session.
Specified studio session identifier does not exist.
Specified source document identifier does not exist in session inputs.
Specified ontology version does not exist in session history.
Agent proposal contains unresolved HMAC pseudonym token in URI, slug, or label.
Multiple external mappings match standard URI when mapping_type was omitted, or duplicate mapping tuple.
Bundle archive violates security limits (path traversal, zip bomb, drive prefix, absolute paths, >250MB, >500 entries, symlinks).
Attribute name specified for removal does not exist on concept.
Automated actor attribution mismatch in delta record or direct mutation envelope.
Cannot delete a session that has been promoted to a live workspace.
Cannot prune a session that has been promoted to a live workspace.
Cannot delete concept because it is still referenced as parent, relationship endpoint, or foreign key.
Session bundle export contains confidential sources and was not acknowledged by operator.
Enumeration code_descriptions dictionary contains key not present in allowed_codes.
Target entity already has a description; revision must use ReviseDescriptionOp instead of SetDescriptionOp.
Duplicate attribute name specified within concept attributes collection.
Duplicate code specified within enumeration allowed_codes.
Relationship name collides with an existing relationship name.
Relationship URI collides with an existing relationship URI in ontology.
Duplicate synonym string specified within concept synonyms collection.
Enumeration code specified for removal does not exist in allowed_codes.
Evidence character offsets exceed bounds of source document text.
Genesis draft transition from 0.0.0 to 1.0.0 requires at least one Canonical Business Concept.
Parent concept assignment introduces a directed cycle in taxonomy DAG.
Promotion rejected due to unacknowledged historical contract warnings on deployed artifacts.
Violation of 1:1 bijection between Canonical Business Concept and physical Hub table.
Imported history contains admin operation or waiver claimed by non-human principal.
Imported history contains destructive operation authored by automated agent actor.
Imported history contains invalid automated actor attribution.
Imported external mapping confidence does not match verify-only BM25 score against reference pack.
Replaying delta on base version does not reproduce recorded target_sha256 or ontology.json bytes.
Imported delta history contains envelope violation or disallowed actor mutation.
Imported session bundle contains low-confidence mappings or unverified grounding without operator acknowledgement.
Imported version history contains broken parent_sha256 cryptographic lineage.
Matcher SHA-256 cited in imported version metadata is not registered on host system.
Imported ontology contains provisional URN token (urn:opendv:provisional:), forbidden in bundles.
Imported session bundle contains self-accepted proposal without required operator acknowledgement.
Recorded version bump in imported delta does not match SemVer rule calculation for operations.
Pinned reference pack cited in imported external mapping is not registered on host system.
Evidence grounding approval snippet does not match CAS source blob byte-for-byte at specified offsets.
Grounding waiver syntax invalid, rationale length < 10 characters, or ungrounded concepts list inconsistent.
Derived or overridden physical table name exceeds 55/63 character limit or violates naming grammar.
Proposal state transition invalid (e.g. resolving a non-pending proposal).
Workspace ontology file fails GraphAOntology schema validation or non-SemVer version string.
External mapping standard URI specified for removal or repinning does not exist on concept.
Cannot delete concept because ontology must contain at least one Canonical Business Concept.
Deployed contract violation: destructive mutation over deployed table or column, or attribution mismatch.
Destructive operation in additive OntologyDeltaRequest or automated actor attempting revision.
Forged provenance detected: committed actor does not match authenticated principal or non-admin evidence approval.
Concept URI fails grammar, uses reserved provisional pattern, or references ungrounded reference ontology URI.
Concept grounding score below 0.65 threshold without admin low-confidence grounding waiver.
Confidential pseudonym token or HMAC leak detected in committed entity string field.
Touched concept has zero reference mappings and zero evidence grounding snippets (strictly ungrounded, never waivable).
Concept already has a parent concept assigned; reassignment must use ReparentConceptOp.
Parent concept URI specified in SetParentConcept or ReparentConcept does not exist in ontology.
Deterministic physical table slug collides with an existing physical table name.
Redacted placeholder token ([REDACTED_ODV_*]) leaked into production ontology entity field.
Target concept URI cited in relationship, parent, attribute, or mapping does not exist in ontology.
Relationship URI specified for deletion does not exist in ontology.
CAS GC cannot purge source file because it is cited as evidence in a committed ontology version.
CAS GC cannot purge source file because it is cited as evidence in a pending proposal.
Physical table mapping undefined or unresolvable for concept or relationship.
Pinned reference_pack_id and reference_pack_sha256 not found in reference ontology registry.
Canonical ontology_version does not equal legacy alias version when both are provided.
Promotion rejected because workspace SHA is not in session lineage history.
Concurrency conflict: base_sha256 does not match current session head_sha256, or concurrent edit detected.
Mutating operation rejected because background job commit or pipeline is currently in progress.
Failed to acquire session, workspace, or job lock within timeout deadline.
Principal identifier already registered in authorization store.
Principal identifier is reserved by system (e.g. human:local_admin).
Proposal has already been resolved (ACCEPTED or REJECTED) and cannot be accepted, rejected, or rebased.
Studio root or local token already initialized (.local_token exists).
Automated agent actor attempted to grant waiver or invoke admin operation.
Automated agent actor emitted destructive mutation in proposal or construction output.
Automated agent actor attempted to overwrite existing human-authored description or metadata.
Automated actor attempted operation restricted strictly to human users (e.g. direct /delta apply).
Automated agent actor attempted to accept proposal (proposals must be accepted by human stewards).
Cross-site request forgery check failed: Origin or Referer header does not match Host allowlist.
Operation requires admin role privilege (e.g. revisions, waivers, self-acceptance override, promote).

error_codes.problem_title: Loopback Privilege Disabled in Remote Mode
error_codes.description: Loopback authentication or admin initialization disabled when server is running in remote mode.
User who triggered proposal cannot accept it without admin override flag (--allow-self-accepted-proposals).
Client attempted operation restricted strictly to server-internal execution (e.g. RescoreExternalMappingOp submission).
Authentication missing, invalid, expired, or failed token resolution.
Request entity, uploaded source file, or session archive exceeds size limits.
